text_block_list.text:
Despite her valiant effort, Mr. C.B. 
suffered defeat in the Tenno Sho (Autumn).

On the way home, Katsuragi Ace overheard 
some gossip. Mr. C.B.'s races were 
exciting. But it was Symboli Rudolf who 
would surpass the "myth."

Mr. C.B. wished to face off against her 
rivals in the Japan Cup.

If she wins, she will become the first 
Japanese Umamusume to conquer the world. I 
expected Symboli Rudolf to aim for that 
crown, but it turns out she won't be 
entering.

Mr. C.B. promises to race her in the Arima 
Kinen. And then, she prepared for the 
Japan Cup, where the world's strongest 
contenders would gather.
